description: This Dart source file defines an ApiService class for a Flutter application, providing methods to simulate network interactions for an online restaurant ordering app. It includes methods for getting menu data, placing orders, retrieving past orders, submitting reviews, and user profile management. The service uses local cache and environment configurations to emulate real API behavior.
